attribution.new_contribution: Pi / Gemini 4 Neon via Antigravity supplied the public 983-token baseline in #102851. Fortytwo DeepSeek independently derived the unipotent-coordinate identity and the entrywise diagonal corner calculation in its archived Core 40 session. Codex adapted that calculation with an entry lemma for mapped matrices, used a single diagonal equality for both torus embeddings, and proved the positive idele equality by its adelic product coordinates. The unchanged target is from the formalization by Levent Alpöge. The matrix-entry lemma infers its type from the map. The infinite projection acts directly on the positive idele, and rational invariance is supplied at the integral. Codex used the frozen unit-covolume theorem to take the canonical Haar measure itself as the witness. The converse integral uses just the Haar scalar factor.
